headline: An unhurried hour with the way you work.
lede: A guided reflection in five parts. One question at a time, in your own words, at your own pace. At the end you receive a written report: your key statement, your profile, and what to do next.
facts: Stop and come back with the same code
Typed or spoken, on a phone or a computer

steps.title: Buy, and get your code
steps.body: Your access code arrives by email in a minute or two. Buy one for yourself, or a two-pack and give the second to a friend or colleague.

steps.title: Answer in your own words
steps.body: Five parts, one question on the screen at a time. Type, or use your keyboard's microphone. Every answer is saved as you go.

steps.title: Receive your report
steps.body: On screen within a couple of minutes, as a PDF to keep, and by email. Your code opens it again whenever you like.

reportHeading: See the report before you buy
reportBody: Every report follows the same layout: a key statement, a five-trait profile, a section for each part, and three things to try. The sample is a full report for an invented person.

twoPack.name: Two-pack
twoPack.blurb: Two access codes. One for you, one to give away.

privacyBody: Answers are stored encrypted and opened only to write your report. The owner sees that a session exists, not what you wrote, unless they open it, and that is logged. You can delete your answers from the report page at any time.
